raw: {"found": true, "passages": ["5.1.4 upon the Disclosing Party's written request, at the earlier of the end of the Term, or receipt of notice from the Disclosing Party of a breach by it of this Agreement or an Annex, the Receiving Party will deliver promptly to the Disclosing Party or, at the Receiving Party's option, will destroy all memoranda, notes, records, reports, media and other documents and materials (and all copies thereof) regarding or including any Confidential Information which the Receiving Party may then possess or have under its control; and", "5.3 Receiving Party shall protect the Confidential Information from unauthorized use or disclosure by exercising the same degree of care that Receiving Party uses with respect to information of its own of a similar nature, but in no event less than reasonable care, until five (5) years from the later of the Effective Date or the date of receipt of such Confidential Information."]}
